description: This Java class 'BaseImageService' manages image resources within the Thingsboard platform, including saving, processing, replacing base64 images with URLs, inline images, and handling image metadata. It interacts with various DAOs and handles image data encoding, decoding, and resource management.

classes.name: BaseImageService
classes.description: Service class for managing image resources, including saving, processing, inline operations, and metadata handling within the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: saveImage
methods.description: Validates and saves an image resource, processing image data and generating descriptors and previews.

methods.name: processImage
methods.description: Processes image bytes to generate resized images and descriptors.

methods.name: generatePublicResourceKey
methods.description: Generates a random alphanumeric key for public resource identification.

methods.name: saveImageInfo
methods.description: Saves image resource information.

methods.name: getImageInfoByTenantIdAndKey
methods.description: Retrieves image info by tenant ID and resource key.

methods.name: getPublicImageInfoByKey
methods.description: Retrieves public image info by resource key.

methods.name: getImagesByTenantId
methods.description: Fetches paginated images of a specific subtype for a tenant.

methods.name: getAllImagesByTenantId
methods.description: Fetches all images of a specific subtype for a tenant.

methods.name: getImageData
methods.description: Retrieves raw image data by resource ID.

methods.name: getImagePreview
methods.description: Retrieves image preview bytes.

methods.name: exportImage
methods.description: Exports image data and metadata for external use.

methods.name: toImage
methods.description: Creates or updates a resource from exported image data, checking for existing images by etag.

methods.name: deleteImage
methods.description: Deletes an image resource, optionally checking for references.

methods.name: createOrUpdateSystemImage
methods.description: Creates or updates a system-wide image resource.

methods.name: calculateImageEtag
methods.description: Calculates an ETag for image data.

methods.name: findSystemOrTenantImageByEtag
methods.description: Finds an image resource by ETag for system or tenant scope.

methods.name: replaceBase64WithImageUrl
methods.description: Replaces base64 image data with image URLs in entities.

methods.name: updateImagesUsage
methods.description: Updates image references in widget types and dashboards.

methods.name: inlineImage
methods.description: Embeds image data directly into entities as base64.

methods.name: getUsedImages
methods.description: Retrieves all images used by dashboards or widget types.

methods.name: inlineImageForEdge
methods.description: Inlines images for edge entities.

methods.name: inlineImagesForEdge
methods.description: Inlines images for dashboards and widget types for edge.
